subject: drama

source.track: IGCSE · ages 14–16 · all candidates take Component 1 (Written examination, with pre-release material) and Component 2 (Coursework)

note: Units follow the syllabus's subject content in teaching order: the three shared content strands (elements of practical drama, performance skills, staging and design) then the two fundamental approaches — moving from script to performance and devising original drama from a stimulus — before the two assessment components. The shared practical strands map to foundational and intermediate lessons; written analysis and coursework performance carry the advanced lessons.

program.title: Performance skills
topics: Creation of role through realisation of character

program.title: From script to performance
topics: Bringing the printed script alive on the stage
Interpreting a published play from a director's viewpoint

program.title: Devising original drama from a stimulus
topics: Developing dramatic material through the devising process
Working with stimuli in the devising process

program.title: Component 1: Written examination
topics: Section A and Section B: extracts from published plays
Section C: reflecting on the devised piece

program.title: Component 2: Coursework
topics: Individual performance from a published play
Group performance from a published play
